title: The School Pickup Code
narration: A stranger collected my daughter using our private school pickup code. Her tablet showed that she had sent him photographs of our alarms and a message saying I still did not remember him. My husband called from abroad and insisted we had no daughter. Her bedroom emptied around me until only her yellow coat remained. Inside its pocket was that day's class photograph. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every child smiled at the camera while I stood behind them dressed as their teacher.
